Even with all this I put up with it, until now. I just needed some music to focus with and that process was just an absolute nightmare to accomplish. Not only do I have to wait 3 to 5 seconds for each topic in the sound section to load but it takes about 2-3 seconds to load the audio as it slowly fades in with a background. And now, if you realize that’s not the sound you want, and you decide to go back and choose another one, you have to confirm on a pop-up that Yes! Very Good, But Has Been Crashing Lately. This is a very good white noise app. I use it every night for white noise while I sleep. I have tried many other white noise apps in the past, and I have deleted all of them within a few days because of the very annoying pay walls that they have set up. This is not the case with Tide, which I have been using for at least 1.5 years now. However, in the past month or so, the app has been crashing midway through the night midway. This has caused the white noise to stop, which wakes me up. This has been a huge problem, and I am not sure why it is occurring. Maybe it is because I have an older iPhone (7)? Either way, I hope the Tide developers look into this crashing problem, but to all the readers of this review who are looking for a white noise app, you should definitely try out Tide, as it is one of the best out there if you don’t want to pay to play white noise while you sleep.
